name: Crab noodle soup
summary: The provincial tourism portal, 9 June 2021, describes a large town bowl of bún riêu with lean pork, crab paste, pork blood, pork hock, and pig’s ear, and calls the broth fragrant. One counter sells from about 15:00 into the evening and is busiest from 17:00 to 18:00. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Town, on the provincial tourism portal’s 9 June 2021 article. This is not the Hanoi crab soup.
howToEat: Go in the afternoon. The portal prints about 15:00 into the evening for one counter, busiest from 17:00 to 18:00. The bowl is large, with lean pork, riêu cua, pork blood, pork hock, and pig’s ear.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: Town. One counter on the 9 June 2021 article sells from about 15:00 into the evening.
seoTitle: Bun rieu in Ben Tre — an afternoon bowl
seoDescription: Ben Tre bún riêu is a large bowl with crab paste, pork blood, hock, and ear. One counter runs from about 15:00 into the evening. The price is check on arrival.
